item.title: Dar tal-Providenza collects €1.56 million in New Years Day fundraiser
item.description: The annual New Year's Day fundraiser in aid of Dar tal-Providenza raised €1.56 million • Money crucial to cover running costs of the home that caters for people with a disability

item.title: Police conduct over 30 roadchecks on New Year’s Eve
item.description: Officers stop more than 700 vehicles as Malta and Gozo welcome 2026, with six drivers testing positive for alcohol

item.title: Age as a mitigating factor in criminal proceedings | Roberta Bonello Felice
item.description: In delivering sentence, the court acknowledged the gravity of the offences and the harm caused to the victim. However, it also considered the mitigating factors presented, including the accused’s clean criminal record, his early guilty plea, and, most significantly, his age at the time of the offence

item.title: Trump threatens US intervention if Iran violently smashes cost-of-living protests
item.description: Protests over economic hardship in Iran turned deadly after demonstrators clashed with security officials • Trump warns US will intervene if Iran shoots protesters

item.title: Home affairs ministry launches community support officers to boost local policing
item.description: The government has introduced Police Patrolling Community Support Officers for the first time, with 34 recruits now deployed to work alongside the Malta Police Force in local communities, focusing on visibility, early intervention and stronger ties with residents

item.title: Maltese jazz great Tony Carr dies aged 98
item.description: A pioneering figure in Maltese jazz and one of the country’s most accomplished musicians, Tony Carr has died on Friday morning at the age of 98

item.title: Four years on, sister of Paulina Dembska renews plea for justice
item.description: Marking the fourth anniversary of Paulina Dembska’s killing, her sister has spoken of enduring grief and mounting frustration that no one has yet been held accountable for the 2022 femicide

item.title: Two players split €1.5 million Super5 jackpot
item.description: The winning numbers were 1, 3, 9, 17, and 20, as the tickets were bought from Żurrieq and St Paul’s Bay

item.title: PN slams governments failure to act after partial house collapse in Birgu
item.description: Government had been receiving warnings about the dilapidated state of the building as early as 2023

item.title: State allowed to appeal interim release order in asylum seeker detention case
item.description: Court allows State Advocate, IPA to appeal a decree ordering the interim release of asylum seeker Ajil Al Muhsen, despite a judge’s sharp criticism of the government’s evidence and his expressed doubts over the merits of continued detention
